items.question: Is this template production-ready?
items.answer: It's a base template — the sections, SEO wiring, and design system are production-ready; the copy and content are placeholders for you to replace.

items.question: Does it really help with SEO?
items.answer: Yes — pages are statically generated at build time, so search engines receive complete HTML per route instead of a JavaScript shell.

items.question: Can I add more languages?
items.answer: Add a locale to `i18n/locales/` and register it in `nuxt.config.ts` — every section already reads its copy from i18n keys.

items.question: How do I deploy it?
items.answer: `yarn generate` outputs static files to `.output/public`; the included GitHub Actions workflow deploys that folder to GitHub Pages on every push.
